summary: The leader deletion bound follows from the good-class product-weight estimate, the midpoint-fiber Brunn--Minkowski bound, and the global fiber-volume budget. The residual-rank and cluster-rank inequalities use the accepted capacities with the correct constants and strictness. For each fixed parity and midpoint, reflection makes the endpoint pairs disjoint, so the scaled metronoid densities have total pointwise coefficient at most one and realize exactly the claimed mass and barycenter. All stated boundary cases and scope limitations are consistent.
